purpose: Test whether case-isolated support-probability calibration improves evidence selection and whether FRC role scores add signal beyond generic retrieval scores.

frozen_crossfit.fold_assignment: uint64(first 8 bytes of SHA-256 UTF-8 case_id) modulo 5
frozen_crossfit.case_isolation: All chunks from one case stay in one fold.
frozen_crossfit.train_policy: For each outer fold, fit on the other four folds only and predict the held-out fold without reading its labels.
frozen_crossfit.model: Weighted L2 logistic regression fitted by deterministic Newton iterations.
frozen_crossfit.standardization: Weighted train-fold mean and population scale; intercept is not standardized or regularized.
frozen_crossfit.case_class_weighting: Each train case has total weight 1; supporting and non-supporting chunks each receive total weight 0.5 within that case.
frozen_crossfit.positive_label: Candidate chunk belongs to a supporting source paragraph.
frozen_crossfit.prediction: Sigmoid probability; no threshold is fitted or used.

frozen_selection.learned_method: Sort by descending held-out support probability, then descending frozen cross-encoder score, lower token_count, ascending candidate_id; scan and skip infeasible candidates.
frozen_selection.hard_constraints: selected count <= top_k and sum token_count <= token budget

frozen_metrics.family_aggregation: Mean within source cases and budgets with equal weight across the three budgets.

next_action_rules.frc_incremental_signal: Freeze the full model and feature contract before any new independent dataset is accessed; only that dataset may support the FRC role claim.
next_action_rules.generic_calibration_only_signal: Do not claim an FRC contribution; independently confirm the generic calibration approach before adoption.
next_action_rules.safety_regression_or_no_signal: Stop this calibration family on revealed MuSiQue and do not tune folds, features, weights, L2, or thresholds.
